svg.title: The stack in six floors and who holds the key to each
svg.desc: Title: “DPI sits on six floors, and someone else holds the key to most”. Simple version. Read bottom up: each floor rests on the one below. Floor, then who holds the key: 6, DPI: ID, payments, data exchange: We run the rails; we rent the hosting. 5, Software and AI: Big Tech platforms and closed models. 4, Cloud and cables: Three US clouds, under US law. 3, Servers and AI chips: Nvidia, sold under US licence. 2, Chip making: One Dutch machine maker, one Taiwanese fab. 1, Minerals: China’s refineries.
